title: The founder answers an investor's questions at several speeds - his own reply time, exact

objects.subject: Bluepeak x Nimbus - retention
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Could you share how the first three pilot teams retained over eight weeks?

Meera Shah
Bluepeak Ventures

questions.text: Share the eight-week retention of the first three pilot teams
questions.quote: Could you share how the first three pilot teams retained over eight weeks?

objects.subject: Re: Bluepeak x Nimbus - retention
objects.body:
Hi Meera,

All three pilot teams were still active at week eight; usage grew in two of them.

Arjun

objects.subject: Bluepeak x Nimbus - pricing
objects.body:

Meera Shah
Bluepeak Ventures

questions.text: Explain how the team tier will be priced after the pilots convert
questions.quote: How do you plan to price the team tier once the pilots convert?

objects.subject: Re: Bluepeak x Nimbus - pricing
objects.body:

The team tier will be priced per seat, with a floor of five seats.

Arjun

Meera Shah
Bluepeak Ventures

questions.text: Say who the first engineering hire after the round will be
questions.quote: Who is the first engineer you plan to hire after the round?

objects.subject: Re: Bluepeak x Nimbus - hiring

A backend engineer who has built sync pipelines before.

Arjun

Bluepeak Ventures

questions.quote: How many teams are in your pipeline for the next quarter?

objects.subject: Re: Bluepeak x Nimbus - pipeline

Arjun

Bluepeak Ventures

questions.text: Name the tool the pilot teams use today instead of Nimbus Labs
questions.quote: Which tool do your pilot teams use today instead of Nimbus Labs?

objects.body:

Arjun
